apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **Releases and auto-update** — one version `vX.Y.Z` for the head unit, the companion apps and the card (the
  companion now takes its version and build number from git like the head unit: `AppVersion` in core). Every merge
  to main with a `feat`/`fix`/`perf` commit releases it: CHANGELOG's [Unreleased] becomes the version's section, and
  the builds go to the public repos `MbIT9I/byd-telemetry-releases` (APKs, unsigned IPA, `update.json`, SideStore
  source) and `MbIT9I/byd-sealion-card` (HACS). The head unit checks every 6 h and installs a newer build over
  Tier F ADB while the car stands still (Налаштування → Фонова робота → Оновлення, with a switch to keep your own
  builds); the Android companion shows the version and an «Оновити» button in «Підключення»; the iPhone updates
  through SideStore; the card through HACS. Not yet run end to end — see `docs/features/auto-update.md`.
- **DVR tab, a taller 360° and full screen on the Камери screen** (owner's layout, Figma 2026-11-11) — **360° | DVR | DMS**.
  DVR is the windshield recorder camera: the head unit's helper reads it from BYD's BMM camera server
  (`android.hardware.AVMCamera.open(11001)` from `/system/framework/bmmcamera.jar`, `camera/BmmCamera.kt`), which pulls
  it as RTSP from the driving controller, and streams it 1920×1080 like the others (`mode":"dvr"`, go2rtc stream
  `byd_dvr`). The controller runs only while the car is on (a wake, the AVM heartbeat and EV Pro's HV request don't power
  it), so on a parked car the helper answers «Реєстратор працює лише з увімкненим авто» without waking anything and the
  apps show their «DVR · авто вимкнене» state. The 360° is now rendered 2:3 portrait (`864x1296`, 90 px/m; one camera at
  110° wide) and fills the screen's height; the chips lie over the video. A double tap on the video opens it full screen
  (360° upright, DVR/DMS turned a quarter for a phone held sideways; ✕ or a double tap closes; the card uses the browser's
  full screen). Aspect, rotation and texts come from core `Cameras.kt`. DVR frames from the shell uid checked on the car
  (recorder unaffected); the phones checked on the iOS simulator against a stand-in car and test HLS streams; the new
  helper is not yet run on the car. See `docs/features/cameras-dvr-and-adas.md`.
- **Status row above the car on Головна (phones and the card)** — four chips, centred and evenly spaced (Figma
  `01 · Головна`, components `StatusChip/…`): padlock, charge bolt + plug, charge/discharge power, speed from the CAN
  bus. Bolt green while `bms_state` is 1; plug green when `charge_gun_state_raw` is 2, red when the flap is open and
  the gun out, grey otherwise; power is the signed pack power (−voltage × current, `+7,4 кВт` charging, `−0,3 кВт`
  discharging, idle under 0,15 kW shows `0 кВт`), not `charge_power_kw`, which reads garbage while idle. Logic in core
  `StatusRow.kt`, so the apps and the card agree. The head unit now publishes what the row needs, all read over Tier F
  and live-checked on the car on 2026-11-11 (parked, on an AC charge): `can_speed_kmh` (HA «CAN Speed»; the MCU speed from
  the `com.byd.gpsinfo` log, or from the speed device when the log has none; `speed_kmh` stays the GPS speed), `doors_locked`
  (HA «Doors Locked»; 1 when all four OTA-device lock states read locked, 0 when any reads unlocked) and `charge_flap_open`
  (HA «Charge Flap Open»; from `getChargingCapState`, 1 while the lid is open). The plug is green for any gun state 2..5
  (AC, DC, AC+DC, V2L), not only 2. Still not seen: the unlocked reading, the lid-closed reading and the speed while
  driving.
  See `docs/features/home-status-row.md`.
